environment.build: Locked offline Rust workspace; probe npm packages pinned in package-lock.json and installed with npm ci --ignore-scripts into a disposable directory.
environment.measurement_runner: Qt Quick/WebEngine offscreen fixture at localhost:8765; Chromium made no CDN requests. Probe bundle generated in a temporary directory.
environment.compositor: Nested Weston startup smoke passed; wtype could not access the virtual-keyboard protocol, so native Wayland input was not sent.
environment.scope: Research-only, test-only framework prototypes. No production adapter, document persistence, runtime dependency, or live-site support claim.

baseline_comparison: Research began from prior S20 evidence tip 014dd87. This commit adds only an isolated framework probe fixture and pinned test dependencies. Production code and the Rust runtime dependency graph are unchanged.

observations: The existing Ferric editor-entry and IME suite passed, including 441 Rust tests (one ignored), 144 QML/WebEngine tests, and native CTest 1/1.
This is generic Ferric mode and composition evidence; the pinned JavaScript framework packages were not mounted for native qualification.

test_results.reason: Nested Weston does not expose the virtual-keyboard protocol required by wtype, so editable-page keyboard and IME input could not be sent.
observations: The bounded Wayland startup smoke passed; it is not treated as input qualification.

Ace, CodeMirror 6, Monaco, ProseMirror, Tiptap, and Quill pinned builds passed consent separation, stale-revision and replaced-owner rejection, bounded framework-native apply, selection checks, and undo restoration.
The rich-text probes preserved unrelated marks for ProseMirror, Tiptap, and Quill. Tiptap focus returned success but did not activate the editor DOM element in this offscreen fixture.
The prototype reports booleans and versions only; no sample document content was emitted.
Pinned framework experiment reran successfully. Tiptap focus did not reach its sink; no complete generic provider gate passed. Existing bounded no-go retained.

scope_amendments: Added crates/ferric-browser-engine-qt/tests/framework-probes/ as an isolated test module for this research slice. Its pinned npm dependencies install only into a temporary directory so the default offline engine suite does not gain a JavaScript package-network dependency; the local HTML fixture remains in the canonical tests/fixtures root.
remaining_risks: The no-go applies to generic cross-framework writeback. Any future framework-specific adapter still needs an owned target/version contract, real independent consent, conflict tests, and native qualification.

The probe validates only the exact pinned package builds in this local QtWebEngine fixture; it does not qualify arbitrary site configuration, collaboration, or mutation by page scripts outside the guarded call.
Tiptap did not reach active DOM focus in the offscreen fixture, despite its focus command returning success.
Two non-fatal WebEngine addRange warnings occurred during the focus/probe lifecycle.
Package-specific native keyboard and IME behavior and live-site behavior remain unqualified.
not_run_reasons: T018/native-wayland: nested Weston lacks the virtual-keyboard protocol needed by wtype; only startup smoke passed.
Pinned framework builds were not mounted in the generic native Qt editor-entry/IME suite, so framework-specific native qualification remains not run.
